data.name: Faq_Subtitle
data.value: Everything you need to know about Rent.ca

data.name: Faq_Q1
data.value: How do I search for rentals?

data.name: Faq_A1
data.value: Use the search bar on the homepage to search by city. You can also ask our AI assistant in plain language — just describe what you're looking for and it will run the search for you.

data.name: Faq_Q2
data.value: Is Rent.ca free to use for renters?

data.name: Faq_A2
data.value: Yes. Searching for rentals, saving favourites, setting up alerts, and using our AI assistant are completely free for renters.

data.name: Faq_Q3
data.value: How do I contact a landlord?

data.name: Faq_A3
data.value: Every listing has a contact form. Fill in your details and message, and the landlord receives your inquiry in their inbox. Your name, email and phone number are shared with that landlord so they can reply.

data.name: Faq_A4
data.value: It's a chatbot that understands plain language. It can search for properties, pull up the details of a specific listing, tell you about a city, and create a rental alert for you — all from the conversation.

data.name: Faq_Q5
data.value: How do I set up alerts?

data.name: Faq_A5
data.value: Create an alert from the Alerts page in your renter portal, or simply ask the AI assistant to set one up. Your saved alerts live in your portal, where you can pause or delete them at any time.

data.name: Faq_A6
data.value: Landlords who display a verified badge have been confirmed by our team. The badge appears on their listings and on their profile card.

data.name: Faq_A7
data.value: We cover major Canadian cities including Toronto, Vancouver, Montreal, Calgary, Ottawa and Edmonton, with more being added over time.

data.name: Faq_Q8
data.value: How do I list my property?

data.name: Faq_A8
data.value: Sign up as a landlord and create your listing from the management portal. Listing is free on the Limited plan; Promoted and Featured upgrades are activated by the Rent.ca team.

data.name: Faq_Q9
data.value: What are my rights as a tenant in Canada?

data.name: Faq_A9
data.value: Tenant rights vary by province. Generally, tenants have the right to a safe living environment, privacy, and protection from unfair eviction. Always check the residential tenancy rules for your own province.

data.name: Faq_Q10
data.value: Something looks wrong — how do I report it?

data.name: Faq_A10
data.value: Rent.ca.NET is a portfolio project and the listings are demo data, so there is nothing to report as fraudulent. If you spot a bug or a mistake in the app itself, please open an issue on the GitHub repository linked in the footer.

data.name: footer.privacyText
data.value: Rent.ca.NET is a portfolio project by Giovanni Richaud. It is not a real rental service — the listings are demo data. When you send an inquiry, your name, email and phone number are shared with that listing's landlord. data.name: Landlords_FaqQ1
data.value: How much does it cost to list?

data.name: Landlords_FaqA1
data.value: We offer three tiers: Limited (free), Promoted ($35 per 15 days), and Featured ($199 per 15 days). All prices in CAD with no contracts.

data.name: Landlords_FaqA2
data.value: Sign up as a landlord and post your first listing in under five minutes. No credit card needed for the free tier.

data.name: Landlords_FaqQ3

data.name: Landlords_FaqA3
data.value: The Limited plan includes a basic listing with up to 5 photos, standard search placement, and a contact form for renter inquiries.

data.name: Landlords_FaqQ4

data.name: Landlords_FaqA4

data.name: Landlords_FaqA5

data.name: Landlords_FaqA6

data.name: Landlords_FaqA7

data.name: Landlords_FaqQ8

data.name: Landlords_FaqA8
